name: urlscan.io (Search API, result API, web pages)
tier_rationale: urlscan GmbH, an established company with published terms, a privacy policy and commercial plans (A8 trusted); P066 'urlscan is an established company: tier trusted', P083 lists urlscan.io as trusted.

reliability.justification: Dated public scan records (page metadata, screenshots, verdicts); results older than 30 days are historical and urlscan verdicts count as one vote (P066).

urlscan.description: urlscan.io API key (API-Key header; search quota)
urlscan.plan_hint: a company key under urlscan's commercial terms, or urlscan's written approval in licence_allow (P066); free use is personal only

search.title: urlscan.io Search API and result API (search only; no scan submission)

terms.quote: Terms: the urlscan.io ToS (verified 2026-11-26) provide the free service 'only for your own personal use' and bar commercial endeavours not approved by urlscan, so free/keyless use is noncommercial.

search.notes: Quote: binding council text (P066 cond 2). /api/v1/search/?q= (size <= 100, at most 2 search_after pages) and /api/v1/result/{uuid}/ only with a key (403 fixture otherwise) (research C0143); X-Rate-Limit-* headers honoured, 429 = RATE_LIMITED. No scan-submission path exists (POST /api/v1/scan/ is never built; a test asserts it): only submissions publish, so publishes_queries stays false (P066). Screenshots and DOM of existing public scans come only from urlscan.io (P066).
search.licensed_alternative: A company key under urlscan's commercial terms or urlscan's written approval recorded in licence_allow (P066); the manual links (urlscan.web_pages) stay available.

web_pages.title: urlscan.io domain, IP and search pages (manual pivot links)

terms.quote: Report links urlscan.io/domain/{domain} and urlscan.io/ip/{ip} are the manual links.

web_pages.notes: Quote: binding council text (P066 cond 8). Class 'open' is the P083 chair-file class for manual links: urlscan.io domain/IP search pages only, never a scan submission (P083, rule 7; research C0189). V3LUM never fetches pivot links itself (P311).

notes: Shared seed for batches p1-G03-1, p2-G01-3, p2-G14-1, p9-G03-3: batches only extend it (urlscan__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). page_capture (P347) lists urlscan.io and its key but has no urlscan submission path; P060 drops urlscan from archive_mining's hosts. Quota: keyless search 30/min per IP with Concurrency-Limit 10 (research C0143, observed) -> rate 0.5/s (published false, 80% budget) and min_interval 2 s; ttl 1 h keeps searches fresh for newly public scans.
